svg.title: Padakan system overview
svg.text: Plan once with a human gate, then everything runs headless: no agent ever asks a question. The only live question to a human is a cost question (lane 4). Records live next to the repo in <repo>-padakan/.
logo, palette, type, voice: written and approved at the plan gate.
ux-designer and design-implementer build UI and reports with it.
PLAN GATE · human in the loop
The user and the orchestrator define the plan together:
1. approve the PRD (architecture, tech stack, security)
2. approve the task plan and its user stories
3. review each capability manifest: the tools every agent gets
4. set the budget: caps per run, task and step
5. approve the brand file (logo, palette, type, voice)
After this gate: asked again only if a step breaks the budget.
CAPABILITY REGISTRY · verify kits by target (what the resolver chooses from)
drive and assert in a browser
Logs also feed the monitor loop

g.text: Web: Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, unit tests
Android: adb MCP on the emulator
EVIDENCE PACK, attached to the PR
1. Video of the change working (browser, simulator, emulator)
2. Architecture of the change: what changed and why
3. Files touched or edited: diff summary, paths, size
4. Tests and CI: generated, run, validated as pass
the orchestrator re-checks each item itself
becomes a task, may be automatic
OOM · restart loop · bad env var
merged change reaches production behind a flag and canary, with auto-rollback

svg.text: manifest: skills + MCPs + local models + verify kit, one tree per task
4 · COST GATE AND DECISION REPORT (the human decides when a step is too expensive)
set by the user at the plan gate:
caps per run, task and step
the task's tests, the full regression suite, diff inspection.
Cost can only affect optional heavy checks (device probes, video,
browser matrix). If a required check is over budget, ask to raise it.
What: the step, and the task it belongs to
Why: the claim it proves, the risk it covers
Cost: low / likely / high, and budget left
Cheaper options, and what each leaves uncovered
skip: not auto-shipped, goes to a human
no answer: stays paused, nothing spent
report and answer go to the audit trail
5 · CRITICAL-FLOW E2E SUITE IN CI (every new feature ships with stories, architecture, a playbook and a spec)
playbook.md: steps and criteria AC1 to ACn
setup.md: what it needs, what it costs
one test per feature, one soft
re-read state, not on the paint
fails the PR if a document is missing,
a story has no criterion, a criterion
has no assertion, or the spec does
twice per change: on the PR preview
before the merge, on staging after it
"not exercised" is never a pass. A criterion the run never judged
shows as not exercised, never as green. The roster of criteria
comes from the playbook, not from what happened to run.
a ledgered failure is KNOWN, not red
it starts passing: red, fix detected
per criterion, embeds its own video
